description: Discover the URL topology, sitemap structure, and hierarchy of a website without compiling individual pages. Use before crawling to identify relevant documentation paths and section boundaries.

include_subdomains.description: Whether to discover links on subdomains of the target host.

limit.description: Maximum number of discovered links to return.

sitemap.description: Strategy for inspecting sitemap.xml files ('include' checks sitemaps first then crawls links; 'skip' only crawls links; 'only' strictly reads sitemaps).

url.description: Root URL or domain to map (e.g. 'https://docs.stripe.com').

name: atlas_map
